resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Pointers to Structs[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Similar to simple pointers, we can also make pointers to structs using the & operator:[code format="go" ]x := Contact{"James", 42}
p := &x[/code]
Pointers to structs are automatically dereferenced, meaning we can access the field values by simply using a dot:[code format="go" codeId="3336"]fmt.Println(p.age) [/code]
[note]We could use [b](*p).age[/b] to access the age field of the struct, but that looks complicated and hard to read. Go allows you to shorten that syntax and simply use [b]p.age[/b] instead.[/note]

resolved.title: 重置定时器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
示例代码定义了一个**Timer**结构，该结构在**main**()函数中初始化。
你需要在程序中添加一个重置功能。

**reset**()函数需要接收一个指向该结构体的指针作为参数，并将字段`seconds`值重置为`0`。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Reset the Timer[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The given code declares a [b]Timer[/b] struct, which is initialized in [b]main[/b]().
You need to add a reset functionality to the program.

The [b]reset[/b]() function needs to take a pointer to the struct as its argument and reset the seconds value to 0.
[note]Do not change the code in [b]main[/b](). Add the [b]reset[/b]() function, so that the code you are given works as expected.[/note]
